caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a fish-shaped mold viewed from above. The mold has a detailed design showing the contours of the fish, with scales, fins, tail, and an open mouth clearly outlined. The mold is mainly dark in color, with shades of black, brown, and hints of blue, giving it a metallic appearance. The edges of the mold are slightly raised, and an attachment hole is visible at one end, likely for hanging. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white surface with some small brown spots scattered across it. The drawing includes a small signature with the name "I. Wenrich" written in blue near the lower right side of the fish mold.
title: Cast Iron Baking Mold
